text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 2) 2011.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 25 Mei 2011.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual adalah diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh dari 25 Mei 2011 hingga 2 Jun 2011.

JADUAL

Daging babi (perut)

DATO' SRI ISMAIL SABRI BIN YAAKOB

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri,

Koperasi dan Kepenggunaan

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 2) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies

Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 2) Order 2011.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 25 May 2011.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for

the period from 25 May 2011 to 2 June 2011.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

[Paragraph 2]

Local beef

Imported beef

Local buffalo meat

Imported buffalo meat (India)

Imported bone-in mutton

Pork (belly)

Pork (lean and fat)

Made 23 May 2011

[KPDN (PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 7; PN(PU2)188/VI]

DATO' SRI ISMAIL SABRI BIN YAAKOB

Minister of Domestic Trade,

Co-operatives and Consumerism
